title: The Green Mile
tagline: Miracles happen in the most unexpected places.
about: A death row guard in 1935 comes to believe the gentle giant on his block can heal, and that he never committed the crime he is set to die for.
cue: Serve the meatloaf when John Coffey gets his last meal.

    StartersMrs Edgecomb's cornbread with honey butterWild Bill only wanted a little corn bread. Skillet cornbread, whipped honey butter.How to make it150g fine cornmeal (polenta)125g plain flour2 tbsp caster sugar2 tsp baking powder1/2 tsp bicarb soda300ml buttermilk2 eggs120g butter, plus 80g soft butter for the honey butter2 tbsp honey1/2 tsp sea salt flakesHeat a 23cm cast iron pan in a 220°C oven with 20g of the butter in it.Whisk the dry ingredients with a good pinch of salt, then whisk in the buttermilk, eggs and 100g melted butter.Pour into the hot pan and bake until golden and a skewer comes out clean.Beat the soft butter with the honey and salt flakes and serve with the warm cornbread.Cornmeal fried okra with comeback sauceJohn Coffey's last meal had okra. Crisp cornmeal okra, spicy comeback sauce.How to make it400g fresh okra, sliced thickly250ml buttermilk100g fine cornmeal (polenta)50g plain flour1 tsp smoked paprika750ml vegetable oil, for frying125g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp hot sauce1 lemonStir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon into a comeback sauce.Soak the okra in the buttermilk while you mix the cornmeal, flour, paprika and salt.Toss the okra in the cornmeal mix to coat well.Fry in batches in oil at 180°C until crisp and golden, then drain and salt.Serve hot with the sauce.Mr Jingles' pimento cheese and crackersMr Jingles is somehow still alive. Sharp cheddar, roast capsicum, crackers.How to make it250g vintage cheddar, grated100g cream cheese, softened80g whole-egg mayonnaise100g roasted red capsicum, finely chopped1/2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp hot sauce1 box small salted crackers2 celery sticks, cut in batonsBeat the cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth.Fold in the cheddar, capsicum, paprika and hot sauce and season with pepper.Pile into a bowl and serve with the crackers and celery.Hot lineLast meal meatloaf with mash and gravyThe meal before John walks the Mile. Glazed meatloaf, buttery mash, onion gravy.How to make it800g beef and pork mince1 brown onion, grated, plus 1 sliced for the gravy60g fresh breadcrumbs125ml milk1 egg2 tsp dried thyme125ml tomato sauce2 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp apple cider vinegar1kg floury potatoes80g butter2 tbsp plain flour500ml beef stock1 bunch silverbeet, shreddedSoak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the mince, grated onion, egg, thyme and plenty of salt and pepper.Shape into a loaf on a lined tray, stir the tomato sauce, sugar and vinegar together and brush half over.Bake at 180°C for 1 hour, brushing on the rest of the glaze halfway, then rest it.Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with half the butter and a splash of the milk.Fry the sliced onion in the rest of the butter until brown, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and simmer into gravy.Wilt the silverbeet in a hot pan, slice the meatloaf thickly and serve with the mash, gravy and greens.SweetsTop Hat peach cobbler with vanilla ice creamJohn's first picture show is Top Hat. Bubbling spiced peaches, buttermilk biscuit crust.How to make it2 x 825g tins of sliced peaches, drained100g brown sugar1 tsp ground cinnamon1 tbsp cornflour1 lemon, juiced200g self-raising flour60g caster sugar90g cold butter, cubed180ml buttermilk1 L vanilla ice creamToss the peaches with the brown sugar, cinnamon, cornflour and lemon juice in a baking dish.Rub the butter into the flour and caster sugar, then stir in the buttermilk to a soft dough.Drop spoonfuls of dough over the peaches, leaving gaps for the juice to bubble through.Bake at 190°C until the topping is golden and the fruit is bubbling.Rest for 5 minutes and serve warm with the ice cream.DrinksFaded limes coolerA floor the colour of faded limes. Lime, mint, raw sugar and soda.How to make it6 limes100g raw sugar100ml water1 cup mint leaves750ml soda water, chilled2 cups ice cubesHeat the sugar and water with strips of lime peel until dissolved, then cool and strain.Squeeze the limes and stir the juice into the syrup.Pour over ice and mint in 4 glasses and top with soda.Coffee, blackLike the drink, only not spelled the same.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
